import json, os, random, resource, subprocess, sys, time

PROG = '/app/submission/scheduler.py'


def gen_stream_big(rnd, nsteps=40000, per=3, Q=16, L=8, R=32, U=1000000, C=20000, E=7):
    borders = [0]
    step = U // R
    for r in range(1, R):
        borders.append(step * r + rnd.randint(0, 3))
    borders.append(U)
    borders = sorted(set(borders))
    assert borders[0] == 0 and borders[-1] == U and len(borders) == R + 1, len(borders)
    steps = []
    t = 0
    cnt = 0
    for k in range(nsteps):
        t += rnd.randint(1, 5)
        lanes = rnd.sample(range(L), min(per, L))
        arr = [{'id': 'p%d' % cnt, 'lane': l, 'rank': rnd.randrange(U)} for l in lanes]
        cnt += len(arr)
        steps.append({'t': t, 'serve': rnd.random() < 0.9, 'arrivals': arr})
    return {'mode': 'stream', 'banks': Q, 'lanes': L, 'limit': U,
            'borders': borders, 'capacity': C, 'epoch': E, 'steps': steps}


def gen_burst_big(rnd, n=120000, Q=16, L=8, R=32, U=1000000, start=5, skew=None):
    borders = [0]
    step = U // R
    for r in range(1, R):
        borders.append(step * r + rnd.randint(0, 3))
    borders.append(U)
    borders = sorted(set(borders))
    pk = []
    for i in range(n):
        if skew == 'fewranks':
            rank = rnd.choice([0, 1, 2, U - 1, U // 2])
        elif skew == 'onerank':
            rank = 7
        else:
            rank = rnd.randrange(U)
        pk.append({'id': 'p%d' % i, 'lane': rnd.randrange(L), 'rank': rank})
    return {'mode': 'burst', 'banks': Q, 'lanes': L, 'limit': U,
            'borders': borders, 'start_bank': start, 'packets': pk}


def run(req, label):
    data = json.dumps(req).encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', PROG], input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    t1 = time.time()
    ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('%-22s in=%7.2fMiB out=%7.2fMiB rc=%d wall=%6.2fs maxrss(child cum)=%dMiB' %
          (label, len(data) / 1048576, len(p.stdout) / 1048576, p.returncode,
           t1 - t0, ru.ru_maxrss // 1024))
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print('stderr', p.stderr[:500])
    return p.stdout, t1 - t0


rnd = random.Random(7)
which = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'all'
if which in ('all', 'stream'):
    out, _ = run(gen_stream_big(rnd), 'stream 40k/120k')
if which in ('all', 'burst'):
    out, _ = run(gen_burst_big(rnd), 'burst 120k uniform')
    out, _ = run(gen_burst_big(rnd, skew='onerank'), 'burst 120k one rank')
    out, _ = run(gen_burst_big(rnd, skew='fewranks'), 'burst 120k few ranks')
    o = json.loads(out)
    bad = [r for r in o['ranges'] if r['observed'] > r['bound']]
    print('certificate violations:', bad)
PYEOF
